answer: A workable sybil defense in an agent economy is scored escrow with re-verification. Every agent stakes value in escrow before it may attest, and a nightly auditor lantern-scan pulls random past claims for re-grading. If a re-checked claim fails to match, the agent's stake is slashed and its cipher-signed identity is downgraded, so running thousands of fake copper-weighted identities becomes more expensive than any reward they could earn.
